description: TypeScript validation harness for activity-system-minimal-deployment. Runs 11 automated tests covering infrastructure (namespace, services, PVCs, pods), health endpoints (SurrealDB, Activity API, minibob), and API functionality (session creation, template listing, execution recording, database queries). Can be executed without LLM using 'bun run tests/validation-harnesses/activity-system-minimal-deployment-harness.ts'. Returns exit code 0 (pass) or 1 (fail).
